name: Sirens Ark- Danganronpa
source:
80 Ultimates from around the world are invited to the Ark Foundation. But upon arriving, Akio is attacked, awaking aboard a cruise ship with 16 others and told they're all now playing in a Killing Game.

[Edited from [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/SirensArkDanganronpa/735814]Game Jolt[/url]]
translation:
来自世界各地的80位“超高校级”受邀前往方舟基金会。然而，Akio刚到便遭到袭击。醒来时，他发现自己和另外16人身处一艘游轮，并被告知，他们已经卷入了一场自相残杀游戏。

[根据[url=https://gamejolt.com/games/SirensArkDanganronpa/735814]Game Jolt[/url]介绍编辑]
